sources.text: Social neuroscience of pain, affect, and psychopathology Research Our philosophy Dr. Monique Smith Meet The Team Contact Us research The Smith Lab focuses on the mechanistic understanding of the neurobiological relationships between social behavior, pain, and emotion, while identifying the neural circuitry that is disrupted in disease models related to empathy, addiction, and depression. Learn more Meet Dr. Monique Smith Dr. Smith is an Assistant Professor at the University of California San Diego (UCSD) in the departments of Neurobiology and Neurosciences. She received both her B.A. and M.A in Psychology from California State University San Marcos and her Ph.D. in Behavioral Neuroscience from Oregon Health & Science University. She conducted her postdoctoral training at Stanford University with Dr. Robert Malenka. More information Lab news Lab , Research Congrats Jie!
